candidates.title: Prepare appointment drafts for review

demandEvidence.chore: Prepare customer-support replies and schedule appointments for a business, tested only with fictional requests and records.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I am looking to build an autonomous AI Agent using n8n (self-hosted version) to fully automate customer support and appointment scheduling for my business.

ease.reason: A synthetic appointment request can test draft routing, but no supplied reference supports CRM, messaging, or scheduling integration.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small service businesses may pay for appointment administration; this request establishes no buyer willingness or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can classify fictional appointment requests and draft confirmations; live integrations and scheduling accuracy remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A proposed loop could prepare drafts from fictional requests, but a person must verify availability and send; no automation capability is documented.

evidence.reason: The request directly names customer support and appointment scheduling, but provides no frequency, fields, rules, or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Assessed a narrow fictional appointment-request triage and confirmation-draft experiment. The provisional mean is below threshold; no supplied implementation reference supports integration, and live health records are out of scope.

candidates.title: Prepare a weekly report from test inputs

demandEvidence.chore: Build a weekly reporting workflow using company-hosted automation.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’m building a weekly reporting workflow on a company-hosted n8n instance.

ease.reason: A beginner can test a report draft from operator-supplied sample rows, but the post gives no report fields or supplied implementation support.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: professional-services teams may pay to prepare recurring reports; this post establishes neither an external buyer nor willingness to pay.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can transform sample rows into one reviewed weekly summary; the company-hosted system and live data access remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed weekly trigger and summary draft are repeatable design choices; a person must validate inputs, figures, and the final report.

evidence.reason: The fresh post explicitly says a weekly reporting workflow is being built, but names no report, inputs, recipients, or repeated operational details.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: assess a narrow draft from synthetic or operator-supplied rows, but the post specifies no report contents and no relevant implementation reference is attached.
